author: ToHubLab
name: Sticky by ToHubLab
short: Keep text, embeds, buttons and command buttons at the bottom of a channel.
description: Automatically reposts a sticky message at the bottom of a channel. Supports plain text, embeds, components (buttons/selects) and clickable command buttons that execute real bot commands. Includes an interactive menu with bilingual UI (EN/DE), per-channel debounce delays, auto-delete for command replies, persistent command buttons that survive restarts, a full overview of all active stickies, and an optional debug mode that logs to a configurable channel.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-guild: channel IDs, sticky message content (text, embeds, component data), command button definitions (label, style, emoji, command, auto-delete delay), per-channel debounce delays, language preference, debug settings and the debug channel ID. No user IDs are stored.
